items.message: The `_RESUME` regex is applied to untrusted comment body text to extract a numeric depth, and the extracted string is passed directly to `int()` after a regex match on `\d+`. This is safe as written — `\d+` constrains the match to digits only, so no injection into `int()` is possible. However, the comment body is otherwise unsanitised and the `_RESUME` pattern uses `re.search` (not `re.fullmatch`), meaning a comment body of `/implement foo --resume 5 bar` will match and return depth 5.
